source.name: Pittsburgh Pirates / MLB.com: Pirates and Sheetz Announce Jersey Patch Partnership
source.note: Club jersey-patch page, read via the Wayback Machine capture of 2026-04-12 because the live mlb.com page blocks scripts. Still the 2026 patch: Blinkfire Analytics' 2026 MLB jersey-patch list (2026-04-20) lists "Pittsburgh Pirates - Sheetz".
source.quote: the Pennsylvania-based retailer will have its logo featured on the sleeves of Pittsburgh Pirates home and away jerseys
